mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.form_id FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = p.space_id AND a.event_id = p.event_id AND a.participant_id = p.id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC, a.id LIMIT 1

SELECT ans.value ->> 'text' AS text FROM fields f JOIN answers ans ON ans.space_id = f.space_id AND ans.event_id = f.event_id AND ans.field_id = f.id AND ans.application_id = app.id WHERE f.space_id = p.space_id AND f.event_id = p.event_id AND f.form_id = app.form_id AND f.system_key = 'COHORT' AND NOT f.hidden LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS participant_id, p.name, coh.text AS cohort, (app.id IS NOT NULL) AS submitted FROM participants p LEFT JOIN LATERAL () app ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL () coh ON true WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND p.id = #{participantId}

SELECT c.id AS check_in_id, c.participant_id, c.status, c.method, c.checked_in_at, c.checked_in_by AS checked_in_by_user_id, ui.display_name AS checked_in_by_display_name, c.cancelled_at, c.cancelled_by AS cancelled_by_user_id, uc.display_name AS cancelled_by_display_name, c.cancel_reason FROM checkins c JOIN users ui ON ui.id = c.checked_in_by LEFT JOIN users uc ON uc.id = c.cancelled_by WHERE c.space_id = #{spaceId} AND c.event_id = #{eventId} AND c.id = #{checkInId} AND c.participant_id = #{participantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkins ( id, space_id, event_id, participant_id, status, method, checked_in_at, checked_in_by) VALUES ( #{checkInId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{participantId}, 'CHECKED_IN', #{method}, #{at}, #{actorUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE checkins SET status = 'CHECKED_IN', method = #{method}, checked_in_at = #{at}, checked_in_by = #{actorUserId}, cancelled_at = NULL, cancelled_by = NULL, cancel_reason = NULL WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{checkInId} AND status = 'CANCELLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin_logs ( id, space_id, event_id, checkin_id, participant_id, action, method, actor_user_id, reason, idempotency_key, created_at) VALUES ( #{logId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{checkInId}, #{participantId}, #{action}, #{method}, #{actorUserId}, #{reason}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'CHECKED_IN') AS checked_in FROM participants p LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.space_id = p.space_id AND c.event_id = p.event_id AND c.participant_id = p.id WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = p.space_id AND a.event_id = p.event_id AND a.participant_id = p.id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED')
mapper.sql: FROM participants p JOIN LATERAL () app ON true LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.space_id = p.space_id AND c.event_id = p.event_id AND c.participant_id = p.id
